_metadata.title: Catering Industry Testimonials Compilation
_metadata.purpose: Social Proof Library for Trust Building

cutandtaste.quote: As a Food & Beverage Producer for both corporate and private clients throughout the US, it is crucial to my business that I align myself with creative, talented and innovative vendors to provide my clients with the best of the best. Cut & Taste Catering is one of my favorite partners.
cutandtaste.author: Food & Beverage Producer (Corporate/Private Events)

creativeedge.quote: Our team's professionalism and attention to detail were evident throughout the entire event. The dishes were not only delicious, but also beautifully presented, adding to the overall ambiance of our event.
creativeedge.author: Event Client (Miami/Palm Beach)

creativeedge.quote: Our team did an outstanding job. Thank you for making the event extra special!
creativeedge.author: Event Client

saltblock.quote: Professional service. Staff Chef Grace, Lead assistant Akima, Kelly and Yoandra arrived early, prepped, prepared, arranged and served in the most subtle seamless way. Clean-up was fast and thorough.
saltblock.author: Wedding Client (Tampa)

saltblock.quote: In addition to dinner service, the team also assisted with our wedding cake, making sure it was presented and served seamlessly. Having a vendor who goes above and beyond makes all the difference.
saltblock.author: Bride/Groom

wolfgangpuck.brand_statement: Chef Wolfgang's legendary passion for food and entertaining at each event.
key_messaging: Setting the standard for culinary excellence

star_rating_displays: Award badges instead of star counts

must_include_elements: Customer name (or first name + last initial)
Date or time period (optional but helpful)
structure_templates: SPECIFIC DETAIL focused (mention a particular dish/staff member)

video_testimonial_notes.recommendation: Video testimonials are underutilized - major opportunity for differentiation
